layers.process: Cabo Polonio National Park: the ministry's page says entry to the protected area can't be made in private vehicles; you must use the vehicles provided for it. The control point is the Puerta del Polonio (bus terminal, parking, the access trucks and toilets). Rangers answer enquiries all year on the phone numbers on the page. No entry fee was found on the official page.
